name: nonApi_ensureTrackAttendance
description: Creates the attendance row for a runner who has a PackTrack trail on a run but no HC.HasherEventMap row (tracks recorded before the app checked the tracker in as tracking starts). Called only by the nightly track archive (TrackArchiver / ArchiveTrack Azure Functions) when a run's partition holds points for a hasher with no row. The insert mirrors a fresh At Hash check-in from hcapp_setEventAttendence and the run counts are recomputed the same way. A row that already exists in any state, including removed, is left alone. 1.1.0 (2026-09-11): a row below At Hash (an RSVP) is raised to At Hash / RSVP Yes as a check-in would; Reason 'raised'. Also called by the track-import processor for every imported activity.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run the trail belongs to. Must exist and not be deleted.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The runner. Must exist and not be deleted.

columns.name: Inserted
columns.description: 1 when a row was created, else 0.

sideEffects: Inserts one HC.HasherEventMap row (AttendenceState 20, RsvpState 3, IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0, KennelId from HC.Event) under UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK on the existence check — fires the HEM updatedAt trigger so the row syncs to the runner's clients.
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser for the runner after the insert, outside the transaction, exactly as hcapp_setEventAttendence does — the runner's run counts change.
On any runtime error: rolls back, logs to HC.ErrorLog (with userId and eventId), re-throws.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
